props.text: What is included in Modrix Commerce
The free core covers the everyday work of running an online store: products, checkout, orders, pages and settings. Here is what it does.
A standard Laravel application, so any PHP developer can read it and change it.
Works with the database your hosting already provides.
The storefront and the admin are React pages served by Laravel.
Change the look of your store with a theme. Styling uses Tailwind CSS.
These features are part of the free core. Modules can add more.
Products, variants, attributes, brands and inventory.
A shopping cart, guest checkout and coupons.
Set up taxes and shipping options for the places you sell to.
Manage orders, use bulk actions and create PDF invoices.
Sell files that customers download after they buy.
See how your store is doing in simple reports.
Write About, FAQ and policy pages with a text editor, SEO fields and menu placement.
Design your home page visually with sections and blocks.
Translate your store and content. A sitemap is created for you.
Give each person the access they need and see who changed what.
Store details, maintenance mode, two-factor sign-in and email through your own SMTP server.
Scheduled backups, and core updates with a rollback if something goes wrong.
Want to look at the code?
Read the install guide, or import the demo pages into your own site.
